title: Page 217
transc:
White House June 20 / 64
Maj. Eckert Washn. & Sheldon Ft Monroe
nine a m we are chester
Been skirmishing about an hour period
prisoner says there are two devons
Rebel dimple period they show no
Carroll yet but it is supposed
they are surrounding us period Sherry
den supposed to be twelve miles
from here now period I will
Burn messages and cipher if I
have to period two gunboats here
Bickford


Ft Monroe June 20th 1864
Maj Eckert Washington Sarah Bickford reports violet oiled now by large saint
zebra have moved myself and office on tremble side
zodiac trains and property coming over fast as possible
unity ravishing hard now virgin Copy sent to Sheldon
Geo. D. Sheldon


White House June 20th 1864
Maj. Eckert Washington 
& Sheldon Ft Monro
two P M cherry den is
near here firing ceased and I
think rebels have backed out will
try to get back to old 
office again quite brisk little battle
Bickford .
